selection: First 10000 nonempty English labels from 11000 direct-instance entities in lexical entity-URI order; editions and mods may be distinct source records
queryTemplate:
PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT ?game ?labelEn WHERE { { SELECT DISTINCT ?game WHERE { ?game wdt:P31 wd:Q7889 . CURSOR_CLAUSE } ORDER BY ?game LIMIT 1000 } OPTIONAL { ?game rdfs:label ?labelEn . FILTER(LANG(?labelEn) = "en") } } ORDER BY ?game
cursorRule: First page omits CURSOR_CLAUSE; subsequent pages use FILTER(STR(?game) > last entity URI). Eleven bounded pages. No live WDQS requests are made by the application.
